title: Serino 2015 · Hand posture software assessment
citation: Serino et al. (2015). Body part-centered and full body-centered peripersonal space representations. Scientific Reports, 5, 18603.
notes: Software assessment of Experiment 5. Runs both hand-posture conditions with 432 scheduled trials, continuous synthetic pink noise, a software tactile cue and mouse-click responses. Replication requires the original hand placements and two-speaker stimulus, calibrated hand vibration, and measured gamepad timing.

published_method.response: Speeded gamepad response to tactile onset. Compare distance-dependent facilitation by hand posture.

software_preview.reason: Offsets derived from the 22 cm/s nominal motion over the published spatial probe grid (near branch of the existing renderer).
software_preview.design_defaults: Use two consecutive 108-trial software blocks per posture (216 per posture) to keep each generated block within the runner’s working-memory limit. The published task compares the postures within participants. The original block splits and realized order are unknown.
software_preview.source: Continuous synthetic pink noise on the same virtual approach path for both postures. No hand coordinates or anatomical motion are inferred.
software_preview.tactile_and_response: The toolkit renders the standard 100 ms cue on the tactile channel and records mouse clicks. Each source clip holds its final virtual position for 100 ms so the latest tactile cue can complete before the intertrial gap.

intertrial_interval.allocation: Paired cells and endpoint baselines cross both fixed gaps with equal repeats. The realized duration stream and complete block order are software choices.

source_provenance.value: Supplement documents noise synthesis with SoundForge 4.5 for the 2-speaker setup.
source_provenance.gap: Exact waveform and channel assets unlocated.

trajectory_path.value: Looming from fixed acoustic positions between the two hand postures.

stimulus_duration.gap: Exact acoustic file duration unavailable. Do not derive it from nominal range until onset position and silence are established.

value.shape: exponential overall level change with opposing speaker activation

gain_envelope.gap: Exact channel coefficients and original waveform unknown.

renderer_or_apparatus.value: Two M-Audio Studiophile AV 360 speakers, one near and one far. SoundForge 4.5 synthesis.

condition_intermixing.value: Five to seven distance cells depending on experiment. Bimodal and unimodal control families.
condition_intermixing.gap: Exact scheduling across conditions and order unspecified.

blocked_or_random_order.gap: Experiment-specific blocks and randomization are recorded when explicitly reported. Exact randomization seeds unknown.

iti_jitter_policy.gap: The original values, draw distribution and realized order are unreported.

response_window.gap: Online response deadline and exact gamepad key unreported.

task_sequence_rules.value: Respond quickly to vibration with designated Xbox 360 gamepad button, sampled at 125 Hz. Ignore the moving cue and withhold on no-touch trials.

tactile_stimulus.gap: Near and far refer to hand posture relative to trunk. Exact hand coordinates not specified.

soa_table.gap: Distances and nominal motion are reported. Exact software onset times, rendering origin and trigger delays are unavailable.

baseline_strategy.value: Two silent tactile timings equivalent to nearest and farthest bimodal samples. Subtract fastest mean tactile-only RT for each participant's comparison.

catch_trial_type.value: Auditory cue with no vibration. Withhold response.

remaining_caveats: The source gives the spatial probe grid and nominal velocity. Original trigger offsets, propagation delays and position-specific sound envelopes are unavailable.
The delivered vibrotactile waveform, actuator acceleration and synchronized gamepad latency require calibration. The 100 ms pulse is the motor command duration.
Exact target-hand coordinates relative to the physical loudspeaker array are unreported.

The published intertrial interval is shuffled between 500 and 700 ms. This software assessment balances the two endpoints, then shuffles trial rows with the stored seed. The study’s exact duration draws, posture-block order and response deadline are unreported.
The operator must set the original physical hand postures and verify acoustic geometry, tactile output and the response device before collecting research data.

provenance.source: https://doi.org/10.1038/srep18603. Article pp. 5–6, Experiment 5 and Fig. 4B
